Swamis sing bhajans extolling Akshar-Purushottam Darshan and Shastriji Maharaj
6.04am: Swamishri's chanting with the mala continues
Hundreds of devotees have filled the assembly hall...
Swamishri arriving early to secure a seat...
Swamishri eager to catch closer darshan of Swamishri
Others are sat in the adjacent gymnasium...
Swamishri while yet more watch on a large screen in the overflow marquee in the mandir grounds
6.16: Swamishri stands to perform his tapni mala
6.18am: Swamishri begins his pradakshinas
Swamishri completes six pradakshinas in total
6.21: Swamishri offers thal to Harikrishna Maharaj and the other murtis
6.27: Swamishri sanctifies water with the holy relics of Bhagwan Swaminarayan and the Guru Parampara
6.30am: Swamishri concludes his puja by reading the Shikshapatri
6.34: As he completes his puja, Swamishri greets everyone with folded hands
The devotees reciprocate with folded hands
6.39: Swamishri's hands are still folded
Children also fold their hands in return
Swamishri asks for the children to stand and come closer so he can greet them properly
Swamishri rings the bell in honour of the resounding propagation of Akshar-Purushottam Darshan by Shastriji Maharaj, thus commencing the day's learning
Swamishri begins the chhavani by addressing the assembly himself
Swamishri blesses the forthcoming English translation of Likhitan Shastri Yagnapurushdas, produced by BAPS yuvatis in the UK
Ishwarcharandas Swami introduces another forthcoming English publication, Mahant Swami Maharaj: Episodes and Incidents from Yogiji Maharaj's Biography
In keeping with chhavani custom, haribhaktas were to enjoy 'Swaminarayan khichdi' for lunch
Swamishri helped prepare the khichdi in the morning, as mahaprasad for all the attendees
Swamishri also prepared khichdi for Thakorji...
Swamishri expertly adding all the ingredients in turn
Swamishri soon returned to the assembly hall, at 9am...
Swamishri listening attentively to the discourses by various learned swamis
At one point, Swamishri asked for the microphone, sharing his own reflections upon the on-going discourses
As devotees reconvened at 4pm, after lunch and a short break, Swamishri joined the discourses again...
Swamishri continuing to listen to the discourses on Akshar-Purushottam Darshan
In his concluding address, Swamishri read out a pledge to Akshar-Purushottam Darshan
Swamishri had spent a total of more than seven hours in the chhavani, and spoken four times
Swamishri concluded the chhavani with the arti of Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj
